meta.description: Popular/known crypto tokens that should not have zero value in rewards, plus stablecoin peg mappings. If a reward for one of these tokens has zero value, it's likely a Koinly data error (missing price data, export issue) and should be flagged for review instead of skipped. The stablecoin_pegs map drives payment-proceeds correction (DP-014); payment tag routing lives in TreatmentConfig.payment_tags (treatment_resolver.py).
meta.maintenance_note: Update this list when new major tokens gain adoption. The list is used for zero-value reward detection in crypto reporting. BEHAVIOR SIDE-EFFECT: tickers listed under tokens.stablecoins are also flattened by classification._load_popular_crypto_tokens, so adding an EUR-pegged stablecoin (EURC/EUROC/EURT) here enlarges the set used for zero-value reward flagging - a zero-value reward for one of those stablecoins is now FLAGGED for review (previously it was not). The stablecoin_pegs keys MUST stay a subset of tokens.stablecoins (enforced by a consistency guard in _load_payment_proceeds_config_from_path that warns on drift).
